panels_big.deck: GTA 6 unlocks at midnight local time worldwide on PS5 and Xbox, after a 99 on Metacritic — joint-highest ever, from 147 PS5 reviews, none negative. IGN gives it 10/10. No PC date yet.

panels_big.deck: At 10:00 in The Hague the ICJ rules on whether Myanmar committed genocide against the Rohingya. Filed by The Gambia in 2019, it would be the first state ever found guilty of genocide.
panels_big.headline: The World Court decides today
